summary: Medallion Financial Corp. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose that the Small Business Administration notified Medallion Capital, Inc. that background checks for two submitted candidates were completed satisfactorily, curing a previously disclosed event of default on its SBA debentures. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, or M&A/activist triggers were disclosed. This is a routine operational/regulatory update with no special-situation elements. No advisor, recommendation, or structural mechanics were mentioned. What to watch: no arbitrage angle exists.
